changelog.p.002: Taƙaitaccen tarihin kowace fitowar PickVia ga jama’a. Sauke sabuwar siga daga GitHub.
changelog.p.003: Zaɓi ƙarin burauzai da nau’o’in fitarwa, tare da tara bayanan martabar Firefox bisa nau’in fitarwar da suke da alaƙa da shi.
changelog.li.001: An ƙara Chrome Dev da Canary; Edge Beta, Dev da Canary; Brave Beta da Nightly; Vivaldi Snapshot; da Firefox Developer Edition da Nightly a matsayin zaɓuɓɓukan burauza dabam-dabam.
changelog.li.002: An ƙara tura hanyoyin haɗi na yau da kullum a matakin manhaja ga Opera, Arc, Orion da Safari Technology Preview.
changelog.li.003: Ana riƙe bayanan martabar Firefox tare da nau’in fitarwarsu da aka rubuta idan an iya gane shi, sannan a cire tsofaffin maimaitattun shigarwar da aka gano lokacin sake bincike. Bayanan martaba da ba su da ingantattun bayanan siffanta alaƙa suna ci gaba da amfani da tsarin madadin da yake nan.
changelog.li.004: An gyara hanyoyin fayil na bayanan martabar Firefox da aka ƙi bayan daidaita hanyoyin wucin gadi na macOS.
changelog.li.005: Ana nuna haɗin zaɓuɓɓukan turawa da ake tallafawa kawai. Tagogin sirri suna ci gaba da zama zaɓuɓɓuka a matakin burauza; babu yanayin sirri na takamaiman bayanin martaba.
changelog.p.004: DuckDuckGo yanzu yana nan a matsayin zaɓin burauza, tare da zaɓin sirri a gine-ginen hukuma da ake tallafawa.
changelog.li.006: Zaɓi DuckDuckGo na yau da kullum ko na sirri daga taga zaɓi ɗaya.
changelog.li.007: Yanayin sirri yana amfani da bayanai keɓantattu na wucin gadi, ba ya buƙatar ƙari ko izinin Sauƙin Amfani, kuma yana aiki a gine-ginen hukuma masu saukewa kai tsaye da ake tallafawa kawai.
changelog.p.005: Google Chrome Beta yanzu zaɓin burauza ne dabam, tare da nasa bayanan martaba da zaɓuɓɓukan yau da kullum ko na sirri.
changelog.p.006: Hanyoyin haɗin imel yanzu za su iya buɗewa a manhajar imel da aka shigar da ka zaɓa.
changelog.li.008: Zaɓi daga manhajojin imel masu rajista kuma ka tsara jerinsu a Saitunan Imel.
changelog.li.009: PickVia ba ya nuna samfotin ko adana masu karɓa, batutuwa, rubutun saƙonni ko asalin hanyar haɗin imel.
changelog.p.007: Fitowa ta farko ga jama’a: zaɓi burauza, bayanin martaba ko yanayin sirri da ake tallafawa ga kowace hanyar haɗin yanar gizo.
changelog.li.010: Ana tallafa wa Safari, Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi da Firefox.
changelog.li.011: Shigar da manhajar ta hanyar jan ta zuwa babban fayil ɗin Manhajoji daga DMG.

index.description.001: PickVia yana ba ka damar zaɓar burauza ko bayanin martaba ga kowace hanyar haɗin yanar gizo da manhajar imel ga kowace hanyar haɗin imel a macOS.
index.alt.001: Taga zaɓin burauza na PickVia mai nuna bayanan martabar burauza, wuraren sirri da gajerun hanyoyin madannai
index.alt.002: Taga zaɓin imel na PickVia mai nuna manhajojin imel da aka shigar
index.alt.003: Saitunan burauza na PickVia tare da burauzai da misalan bayanan martaba
privacy.p.002: Ta fara aiki ranar 14 ga Agusta, 2026
privacy.p.003: PickVia ba ya tattarawa, aikawa, sayarwa ko raba bayanan mutum. Manhajar ba ta da asusu, nazarin amfani, talla ko aika bayanan aiki.
privacy.li.001: Ana sarrafa hanyoyin haɗi a cikin na’ura kuma a tura su kai tsaye zuwa burauza ko manhajar imel da ka zaɓa.
privacy.li.002: PickVia ba ya rubutawa a rajista ko riƙe URL da aka buɗe, masu karɓa, batutuwa ko rubutun saƙonni.
privacy.li.003: Ana adana saituna a cikin babban fayil ɗin Application Support na na’urarka.
privacy.li.004: Lokacin da ka ba da damar shiga bayanan martabar burauza, PickVia yana adana alamar wuri ta cikin na’ura mai iyakantacciyar damar tsaro, kuma yana karanta bayanan siffantawa da ake buƙata don gano bayanan martaba kawai. Ba ya karanta tarihin lilo, kukis, zaman amfani, kalmomin sirri da aka adana ko abin da shafi ya ƙunsa.
privacy.p.004: Shafin PickVia ba ya amfani da nazarin amfani, masu bin diddigin talla, fom ko kukis da PickVia ya saita. Ana masaukinsa a GitHub Pages. GitHub na iya sarrafa bayanan fasaha na buƙata bisa Bayanin Sirrinsa.
privacy.p.005: Burauzai, manhajojin imel, GitHub da sauran sabis da ka zaɓa ka buɗe ko ziyarta suna da nasu hanyoyin kiyaye sirri. PickVia ba ya sarrafa waɗannan sabis.
privacy.p.006: Idan wannan manufa ta canza, za a wallafa sigar da aka sabunta da ranar fara aikinta a wannan shafin.
privacy.p.007: Ana iya aika tambayoyi game da sirri zuwa bozhenpeng93@gmail.com.
terms.p.002: Sun fara aiki ranar 14 ga Agusta, 2026
terms.p.003: PickVia manhajar macOS ce ta kyauta mai buɗaɗɗiyar lambar tushe. Za ka iya amfani da ita, kwafa ta, gyara ta da rarraba ta bisa Lasisin MIT da yake cikin aikin.
terms.h2.002: Ba a buƙatar asusu ko saye
terms.p.004: PickVia ba ya buƙatar asusu, biyan kuɗin lokaci-lokaci ko kuɗi. Ana samar da saukewa ta fitowar hukuma na aikin a GitHub.
terms.p.005: Kai ne ke da alhakin yanke shawarar ko za ka shigar da PickVia ka yi amfani da shi, zaɓar manhajojin da za su karɓi hanyoyin haɗinka, kiyaye Mac ɗinka da bin dokokin da suka dace. Ka kauce wa kariyar Gatekeeper ta macOS ne kawai idan ka amince da fitowar da ka sauke.
terms.p.006: Ana samar da PickVia «yadda yake», ba tare da kowane irin garanti ba. Iyakar da doka ta yarda, mai haɓakawa ba shi da alhakin lalacewa ko asara da ta samo asali daga amfani da PickVia ko kasa amfani da shi.
terms.p.007: PickVia zai iya buɗe burauzai, manhajojin imel, shafuka da sabis na wasu ɓangarori. Waɗannan kayayyaki suna ƙarƙashin nasu sharuɗɗa, kuma PickVia ba ya sarrafa su ko ba su amincewa.
terms.p.008: Ana iya sabunta PickVia, canza shi ko daina samar da shi a kowane lokaci. Haka kuma ana iya sabunta waɗannan sharuɗɗa, tare da wallafa sabuwar siga da ranar fara aiki a nan.
terms.p.009: Ana iya aika tambayoyi game da waɗannan sharuɗɗa zuwa bozhenpeng93@gmail.com.
release.v1_5.title: Siga 1.5
release.v1_5.safari: Gwada bayanan martabar Safari Stable na gwaji tare da izinin Sauƙin Amfani da Aiki ta Atomatik. Kowace hanyar haɗi tana buɗewa a sabuwar taga ta bayanin martabar da aka zaɓa.
release.v1_5.duckduckgo: An sauƙaƙa dawo da zaman sirri na DuckDuckGo da share bayanansa. Gine-ginen 1.203.x masu dacewa waɗanda ba su cikin sandbox suna tallafa wa tura hanyoyin haɗi na sirri; hanyoyin yau da kullum ba sa buƙatar takamaiman siga ko sa hannun mai wallafawa.
release.v1_5.signing: Ana amfani da takardar shaidar Apple Development guda ɗaya a kowane gini. Ba a yi wa abin saukewa notarization ba; bi umarnin shigarwa a README.
